project.name: n8n-web-application-portfolio
project.productType: personal n8n freelancer portfolio and landing page

patterns: left-aligned personal hero with warm glow and level workflow canvas

must: Present the three workflow offerings as services Neeraj can build, without claiming completed client engagements or measured results
Keep personal freelance positioning and a clear contact path
Support keyboard controls, visible focus, reduced motion, and small screens
Keep the brief builder local unless server-side delivery is configured; show confirmed delivery states only after the receiver accepts the enquiry
avoid: Invented clients, testimonials, metrics, credentials, or experience
Dead demo buttons and fabricated project repository links
Contact delivery to a placeholder email

decisions: User approved automatic enquiry emails through Resend to the supplied owner inbox. Preserve the existing form design, disclose third-party processing before submission, and distinguish provider acceptance from inbox delivery. Local brief and email-draft fallbacks remain available without credentials.
User asked for a distinct identity after the reference-informed version felt too similar to the reference.
Present workflow offerings with the name and business purpose before the visual; show tools and a short challenge/build/goal narrative, with technical steps inside How it works.
Place workflow offerings early, followed by services, toolkit, profile, process, FAQ, and contact. The workflow playground was removed at the user's request.

Preserve keyboard navigation, native dialog and disclosure behaviour, reduced motion, and honest enquiry states. The user authorised configurable server-side delivery while personal details remain pending.

After a visual review, the owner requested a client-facing portfolio without textbook or demo captions. Remove illustrative-system labels, repeated example badges, system-brief numbering, and fake live indicators. Describe what can be built; reserve client case studies and measured results for supported work.

User selected the supplied dark automation reference: near-black charcoal, warm orange #ff9b6a, a static subtle hero glow and fading grid, neutral workflow screens, and unchanged official coral n8n artwork. This supersedes previous blue and pink theme decisions. The decorative globe is removed.
